name: Gamescom
blurb: The world's largest trade and consumer event for computer and video games, with publisher reveals, Opening Night Live and a cosplay contest in Cologne.

editions.evidence: Homepage: '#gamescom 23.-29.08.2027 open for public: 26.-29.08.2027'; meta description: 'gamescom 2027: The world's biggest event for computer and video games from 23-29 August 2027 in Cologne.'

notes: Trade days (incl. gamescom dev and Opening Night Live) run 23-25 Aug, public days 26-29 Aug 2027; no individual autograph-style guest roster is published, only a 'Creators' content-creator partner list and the Gamescom Cosplay Contest, so guests is 'none'.
